experiment: L10 one-pass train-only raw CPT followed by unchanged L6 behavioral SFT
blind_judge: One local Mistral Small 3.2 24B model judge, not human ratings
cpt_interpretation: Step 3 reduced heldout raw-LM loss versus B0 by only 0.001503 and CPT-only fixed50 outputs remained mostly prose. C2 has small individual-score and line-shape gains over L6, but 45/50 direct L6 comparisons were ties and its output prefixes frequently match L6. A substantive causal creative benefit is not established.
sft_preservation_interpretation: There was no clear CPT-only lyric-writing gain to preserve. The unchanged SFT stage imposed the familiar L6 lineation and shortening pattern; it improved cadence, indirectness, and completeness ratings relative to CPT-only while lowering prompt-contact and imagery ratings. The direct judge preferred CPT-only on 17 prompts and C2 on four, with 29 ties.
usability_gate_status: No catastrophic fixed17 or novel20 decline, but C2-40 still passes only 4/17 fixed and 3/20 novel criteria, has five fixed50 below-minimum outputs, and misses important negation/relation/refrain requirements.

one_next_experiment.name: Train-only stylistic target curation under the unchanged L6 SFT recipe
one_next_experiment.rationale: One-pass low-LR CPT changed raw loss and final behavior only slightly, while generic prose and weak imagery/phrasing remain. A predeclared curation of complete, strongly lineated, distinctive passages from the existing 84 training works tests training-target quality directly without another CPT sweep or new corpus text.
one_next_experiment.design_boundary: Review and select only existing training-work passages before model runs; hold the pinned base, L6 optimizer, effective token/update budget, fixed50 prompts/seeds, heldout works, blind rubric, and memorization gates constant. This is a proposal, not an authorized L11 run.

limitations: The individual judge and pairwise judge disagree in some comparisons; 45/50 L6-vs-C2 pairs were ties.
The judge's generic_prose tag counts do not consistently track its own G penalty, so prose conclusions combine separate deterministic and full-response checks.
One judge and 50 prompts do not establish human creative preference; fixed17 and novel20 are small internal criterion audits.
No exact/fuzzy or 16-token continuation flags is not proof of originality.
